vault.unavailable: The vault could not be read, so it is not known whether one exists on this device.

create.title: Create the vault
create.description: The vault password protects every credential saved on this device. It is not stored anywhere and cannot be recovered: if it is lost, the saved sessions and keys are lost with it.
create.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.

unlock.title: Unlock the vault
unlock.description: Enter the vault password to reach the saved sessions and their credentials.
